title: All rooms **or none**
rooms.question: undo?
byhand.head: Written by hand, you also write…
byhand.items: give up on a hotel that never answers
cope with an answer that arrives too late
declare.n1: `forEach` — one run per room, each a small flow of its own
declare.n2: `compensable` + `compensationStepId` — every room that was booked is cancelled
declare.n3: `compensateAll` — let every room finish; if one failed, **undo the rest**
retries.n2: `timeout: PT30S` — no answer fails the attempt, and it is retried too
http.n1: `HTTP_CALL` — no worker to write; the base URL lives in configuration
http.n2: `Idempotency-Key` — the same key on every attempt: a retry never books twice
http.n3: `DELETE` — and **404** counts as success: cancelling is idempotent too
pol.head: onIterationFailure
pol.items: books what it can, reports the rest
lets every room finish — if one failed, undoes the rest
pol.notErrorTail: the process did what it was written to do
pol.opt2: `compensateAbandoned` — END: the branches it cuts short
